_om: Maneten in English: Bloop. British English; key = the Norwegian text (rusj/SPRAK.md).
Hold fingeren nede for å svømme opp – sl: Hold your finger down to swim up – let go to sink.
Hold mellomrom nede for å svømme opp – s: Hold space down to swim up – let go to sink.
Maneten svømmer gjennom en undervannshul: Bloop the jellyfish is swimming through an underwater cave. You steer just one thing: up or down.
Hold fingeren nede – hvor som helst på b: Hold your finger down – anywhere on the board – and the jellyfish swims up. On a keyboard: hold space or the up arrow.
Let go, and the jellyfish slowly sinks.
Ikke treff veggene, steinene eller kråke: Don't touch the walls, the rocks or the sea urchins. Pick up the pearls on the way – every one is counted.
Korte trykk gir små hopp. Lange trykk ta: Short presses give small hops. Long presses take you a long way up.
Hulen blir trangere og maneten raskere j: The further you get, the narrower the cave and the faster the jellyfish.
Fra 120 meter begynner noen kråkeboller: From 120 metres, some sea urchins start bobbing up and down. There is always room above them.
Krasjet du? Trykk en gang til, så er du: Crashed? Tap once more and you're off again. Beat your best and you'll see the whole result.
Spillet tar pause av seg selv hvis du by: The game pauses by itself if you switch apps. On a keyboard, P or Esc pauses.
Maneten går i sanntid og kan dessverre i: Bloop runs in real time and sadly can't be played with a screen reader.
Hold for å svømme opp – slipp for å synk: Hold to swim up – let go to sink.
A new personal best! The last one: {n}.
Første tur – nå har du en rekord å slå!: Your first swim – now you have a best to beat!
Try again – the sea is waiting.
